english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for starting an app or program.

exampleSentences.english: I can launch the program with one tap.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gam6 zau6 hoi1 dou2 go3 cing4 sik1

english.note: Use this for switching something on, especially lights, appliances, and devices.
Use this for turning on a device function, feature, or setting, rather than for giving a person the ability to act.

exampleSentences.english: I enable the location feature on my phone.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我部手機開咗定位功能。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1 hoi1 zo2 ding6 wai6 gung1 nang4
